list.name: agent_type
list.label: Agent Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent_type FROM gateway.commands ORDER BY agent_type

panels.title: Response Time Histogram by Agent Type

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent_type, (FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - created_at)) / 5) * 5)::int AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM gateway.commands WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ($__timeFilter(created_at)) AND ('${agent_type:raw}' = '$__all' OR agent_type IN (${agent_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, agent_type || ' success' AS metric, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) END AS value FROM gateway.commands WHERE ($__timeFilter(created_at)) AND ('${agent_type:raw}' = '$__all' OR agent_type IN (${agent_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, agent_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM created_at)::int AS dow, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at)::int AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM gateway.commands WHERE ($__timeFilter(created_at)) AND ('${agent_type:raw}' = '$__all' OR agent_type IN (${agent_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT date_trunc('day', r.created_at) AS time, r.response_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM gateway.responses r WHERE ($__timeFilter(r.created_at)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT agent_type, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - created_at)))::numeric, 1) AS avg_duration, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) END AS success_rate FROM gateway.commands WHERE ($__timeFilter(created_at)) AND ('${agent_type:raw}' = '$__all' OR agent_type IN (${agent_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY agent_type ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (decided_at - created_at)))::numeric, 1) AS avg_time, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (decided_at - created_at)))::numeric, 1) AS p95_time FROM gateway.approvals WHERE status IN ('approved', 'denied') AND ($__timeFilter(created_at)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT trim(to_char(created_at, 'Dy')) || ' ' || EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at)::int || ':00' AS period, COUNT(*) AS commands FROM gateway.commands WHERE ($__timeFilter(created_at)) AND ('${agent_type:raw}' = '$__all' OR agent_type IN (${agent_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY trim(to_char(created_at, 'Dy')), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) ORDER BY commands DESC LIMIT 10
